$Comment: MMO Mob Scaling BOSS tagset (native NPCGroup): the AMBIENT world bosses this mod scales, the ones a player meets where they roam, spawned by the world rather than by a script. Two independent things key off membership. (1) Rarity: any rarity tier that names this group in its Families.ForceGroups is FORCED onto every member, bypassing weight, difficulty band and spawn chance; the shipped Rarities/Boss.json does exactly that, which is what grants the boss tier here. Point a different tier's ForceGroups at this group to change that, or clear the boss tier's ForceGroups to stop forcing entirely. (2) Scope: members are classified SCOPE_BOSS, which caster-roster entries gate on via 'Scope': 'BOSS'. A boss an encounter script runs (a Server/EncounterManager fight raised from a ManualTrigger spawn marker, or bound to a live encounter) does NOT belong in this list: the encounter already owns its stats, so this mod leaves it alone whether or not its role appears here, and listing it changes nothing. Entries are ROLE ASSET IDS (the Server/NPC/Roles/*.json filename), never in-game display names - an unresolvable non-wildcard entry is skipped with an engine warning. Wildcards use native IncludeRoles semantics, so '*Broodmother' catches a whole family. Owner/pack-editable: override this file to add or remove roles.
